The '''Imperial Corrections officer''' commonly abbreviated as '''ICO''' was a title given to some [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] who worked in the [[Imperial Corrections Service]]. Their ranks were comprised on normal [[Human/Legends|Humans]] ranging in age from late-teens to mid-fifties. They wore face visors to protect against out lashes and had bright orange bio-gear suits in some cases which they could wear to prevent exposure to most disease and viruses.
